flags.headline: VLO -4.77% on 9/21 -- profit-taking/technical pullback after an extended rally into record refining margins
flags.detail: Multiple outlets attribute the move to profit-taking and technical consolidation, with rising crude oil prices raising margin-compression questions, rather than any new negative company event. Morgan Stanley raised its price target to $411 the same week, and Valero also disclosed routine board-composition changes (Matt Audette added to the Audit Committee) via an 8-K on 9/18 -- non-material to the flag. Q3 2026 earnings due 2026-10-22.
flags.thesis_link: Loosely touches VLO key_risk 'refining margin cyclicality -- the record Q2 2026 margins may normalize' but this read is a technical pullback, not evidence of margin normalization yet -- not escalating.

flags.headline: RESOLVED: QCOM +9.09% on 9/21, rejoining the broad AI-chip rally; Apple-modem risk now quantified but market is pricing the Amazon offset, not the loss
flags.detail: The prior 3-session AMBER (-11% cumulative) reflected rally-unwind, not a deterioration in the underlying thesis. This run's search found the risk has in fact been quantified since: on Sept 8 management said its share of upcoming iPhone launches would be 'materially lower' than the prior 20-25% estimate as Apple's in-house C2 modem shipped in the iPhone 18 Pro, with Apple-product revenue expected to fall roughly 50% in the Sept-Dec quarter -- a real instance of the disclosed key_risk materializing. But management also framed FY2027 non-handset (data-center/AI, incl. the new multi-generational Amazon partnership) growth as replacing the entire lost Apple revenue within the year, and the stock's reaction (+9.09% on 9/21, riding the same Meta-Muse-driven chip rally that lifted AMD past $1T) suggests the market is currently crediting that offset. Downgrading to resolved/green rather than escalating -- flagging the nuance for the desk rather than calling a direction.
flags.thesis_link: QCOM key_risk 'Apple modem internalization' has now materialized with management-quantified magnitude, but is being offset by a new, market-credited growth driver (Amazon AI data-center partnership) -- net effect on the thesis is currently neutral-to-positive per price action, not a red flag.
